collection_note: 250 first whitelist template lacked safe missing Health-map access; retry uses index without reading test or logs

findings.title: No explicit container PIDs cap
findings.interpretation: PidsLimit=null means no explicit per-container PIDs cap in this metadata; it does not prove absence of inherited guest/systemd limits.

findings.title: Penpot has six services without Docker health status
findings.interpretation: running alone is not application health proof. Existing external/functional evidence is separate; this audit did not read health commands or run probes.

findings.title: Penpot startup unit is oneshot, with no demonstrated automatic failure recovery
findings.interpretation: Mount-gated startup is present; continuous stack supervision and automatic recovery are not demonstrated by the current unit metadata.

findings.title: Summed CPU caps exceed VM vCPU in test-data and Penpot
findings.interpretation: These are shared ceilings, not reserved CPUs. Guest vCPU remains the aggregate execution boundary; simultaneous cap use cannot be promised. No load test performed.

findings.title: Three source-built Penpot image references use tags
findings.interpretation: Actual image IDs and linux/amd64 were captured; tags can be reassigned. Worker/import IDs match prior preload evidence; frontend has a newer observed image ID, requiring its build provenance rather than the old frontend preload ID.

findings.title: NAS unit uses mount BindsTo and Docker Requires, without Docker BindsTo
findings.interpretation: Different from the five other continuous supervisors; readonly inspection does not prove daemon-loss recovery behavior. Existing NAS guest reboot evidence remains separate.

limitations: Read-only point-in-time metadata audit; no restart/rebuild/load tests
No Env, Cmd, health test/log, labels or application/container logs requested
Running/no-health services are not signed off as application-health passed
CPU/memory limits are upper bounds, not reserved resources or guaranteed concurrent throughput
No source Nexus/other Mac Docker instance queried; only specified guest221 metadata
VM240, templates, PVE and all other guests excluded
